result.instructions: Tools for 1CRM, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which open opportunities are worth more than 10,000 and close this month?"; "Show the contacts of the account Acme Ltd."; "Create a new lead for Jan Novak from the website form.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes 1CRM data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run onecrm_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run onecrm_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run onecrm_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. onecrm_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: onecrm_whoami
tools.description: Show the 1CRM user the connection signs in as (id, user name, name). Use it to check the connection.

tools.name: onecrm_get_module_fields
tools.description: List the fields of a 1CRM module with their types and labels. Use it before you filter, sort or write a module.

module.description: 1CRM module, for example Contact, Account, Opportunity, Lead or Case

annotations.title: List the fields of a module

tools.name: onecrm_list_records
tools.description: List records of a 1CRM module, with optional equality filters, text search, sort, fields, offset and limit (max 100). Returns records and total_results. Use onecrm_get_module_fields for the field names.

module.description: 1CRM module, for example Contact, Account, Opportunity, Lead or Case

filters.description: Equality filters: field name to value

fields.description: Fields to return (default: the 1CRM default set)

tools.name: onecrm_get_record
tools.description: Get one record of a 1CRM module by id, with all fields or only the fields you pass.

module.description: 1CRM module, for example Contact, Account, Opportunity, Lead or Case

id.description: Record id, as returned by a list

fields.description: Fields to return (default: the 1CRM default set)

tools.name: onecrm_list_related_records
tools.description: List the records linked to one record through a relationship link (for example the contacts of an account). The link name is the relationship name from onecrm_get_module_fields. Same paging and filters as onecrm_list_records.

module.description: 1CRM module, for example Contact, Account, Opportunity, Lead or Case

id.description: Record id, as returned by a list

filters.description: Equality filters: field name to value

fields.description: Fields to return (default: the 1CRM default set)

tools.name: onecrm_create_record
tools.description: Create one record in a 1CRM module from the field values you pass (for example a new Lead). Creates only; it changes no existing record. Returns the new id.

module.description: 1CRM module, for example Contact, Account, Opportunity, Lead or Case

data.description: Field values of the new record

tools.name: onecrm_update_record
tools.description: Change the fields you pass on one existing record of a 1CRM module. Only the given fields change. It never deletes a record; use the 1CRM interface for that.

module.description: 1CRM module, for example Contact, Account, Opportunity, Lead or Case

id.description: Record id, as returned by a list

data.description: Fields to change, with their new values (null clears a field)
